verdict.rationale: Hatchet clearly ships first-party SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby. The docs list all four SDKs, and community users confirm multi-language workers. However, nothing in the evidence shows real feature parity across those SDKs, and a community comment notes the docs are heavily Python-focused. Missing for 10: evidence of feature parity across SDKs, per-language docs depth for TypeScript, Go and Ruby, and independent hands-on reports of non-Python SDK usage.
